text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! The leaves are dyed in autumn colors!
Swaying in the wind, it's so marvelousâª

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Man, this really has a nice atmosphere.
It kind of makes me feel a bit lonely, though...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Why, why!?
Look how Marvelous these colors are☆

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, yeah, but somehow
that feeling of heading into winter, you know~?"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: I'm not lonely at all! It's so much fun! Look, when you step on the fallen leaves like this—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Crunch, crunch♪ Crunch, crunch♪
I can even hear marvelous melodies☆

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I see. In Marvelous's hands, even autumn leaves turn into something lively and fun, huh?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Come on, you too, Nature!
Crunch crunch♪ Crunch crunch♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Nah, I'm good.
I'll leave it for when some little kid comes by.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Mm. This feeling... it's kind of nostalgic,
and... feels pretty nice...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Right, right?!
Autumn leaves are truly marvelous, after all!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's dive into the carpet of fallen leaves together!
Ready, set, go-o-o!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hyaa, that startled me.
Out of the blue... though she's always been like that, huh.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Super pretty and Marvelous☆
Feels wonderful to touch, Marvelous★
A Marvelous you can only enjoy in autumn☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Tahaha... Being with you blows away all that autumn loneliness.
